text: A trunk has native VLAN 1 at one end and native VLAN 99 at the other. What happens?
choices: The trunk fails to come up
Untagged frames from VLAN 1 are placed into VLAN 99, silently merging two broadcast domains
explanation: There is no error; there is simply connectivity that should not exist, which is worse than an outage because nobody notices. The same native-VLAN provision enables the double-tagging VLAN hopping attack.
